description: This script checks for unresolved merge conflict markers in tracked files within a Git repository. It provides functions to list files, detect conflict markers in file contents, and report conflicts with file locations.

methods.name: isBinaryBuffer
methods.description: Determines if a buffer contains binary data by checking for null bytes.

methods.name: findConflictMarkerLines
methods.description: Identifies lines in content that contain conflict markers from a merge conflict.

methods.name: listTrackedFiles
methods.description: Lists all files tracked by git in the current directory, defaulting to the current working directory.

methods.name: findConflictMarkersInFiles
methods.description: Checks multiple files for conflict markers and returns violations with file paths and line numbers.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point that runs the conflict marker check across tracked files and reports violations.
